summary: Build Task Manager Application with Agentic SDLC Sync
description:
Implement an enterprise-grade task manager application with automated SDLC documentation sync.

As an engineering team, we want to establish a secure, modular, and automated SDLC workflow using structured agents and strict quality rules, so that we can streamline software delivery and maintain repository integrity.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All 8 SDLC phases (.claude/agents/) must be mapped to their respective artifact files (docs/MDP-7/).
Pipeline state transitions must be tracked with persistence checks in docs/MDP-7/pipeline-state.json.
Hardcoded secrets, API tokens, or sensitive credentials are strictly prohibited in source code or artifacts.
Direct commits to the main branch are not allowed; proper feature branching must be followed.
After the implementation phase, test suites must be run and verification output must be saved in 07-verification-report.md.
The final step must produce a clean Pull Request summary.
